title: Novel Activators of the Transcription Factor PPARgamma for Beef Quality through Molecular Modeling.
authors: Nogueira, Artur G; Mancini, Daiana T; Santos, Tainah M R; Ramalho, Teodorico C
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子建模、虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟寻找牛PPARgamma激活剂，虽涉及转录因子-配体互作而非TF-DNA结合，但结构建模与对接方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系研究。
abstract: Tropical beef has low marbling and variable intramuscular lipids, making the meat appear between dry and juicy due to the lack of intramuscular fat. The objective of this work is to obtain the 3D structure of bovine PPARgamma and discover new compounds that activate it. The target sequence used showed high sequence identity with the human PPARgamma protein model. Virtual screening and molecular docking identified compounds that activate human PPARgamma. The docking parameters were validated through ROC curve and redocking, and a virtual screening resulted in 274 compounds for further research. After applying filters, 12 compounds showed better affinity with PPARgamma and lower toxicity compared with the reference ligand. Compound 3 and Compound 4 showed favorable interactions with PPARgamma in molecular dynamics simulations, raising expectations for the discovery of new activators.
abstract_zh: 热带牛肉大理石花纹少，肌内脂质含量多变，由于缺乏肌内脂肪，肉质介于干涩与多汁之间。本工作的目标是获取牛PPARgamma的三维结构，并发现能够激活它的新化合物。所用靶标序列与人PPARgamma蛋白模型显示出高序列一致性。虚拟筛选和分子对接识别出激活人PPARgamma的化合物。对接参数通过ROC曲线和重新对接进行了验证，虚拟筛选得到274种化合物供进一步研究。应用筛选条件后，12种化合物与PPARgamma表现出更好的亲和力，且与参考配体相比毒性更低。在分子动力学模拟中，化合物3和化合物4与PPARgamma显示出有利的相互作用，为发现新激活剂带来了期望。
